name: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd

documents.title: Filing Of Application For Reclassification With Stock Exchanges
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd (SPARC) held its R&D Day conference call to provide updates on its prioritized pipeline programs in oncology and immunology. Management discussed the progress of clinical assets such as SCD-153 for alopecia areata and SBO-154 (MUC1 ADC), along with strategic shifts including cost-structure optimization, NewCo formations like Tiller Therapeutics for SCO-155, and updates on the priority review voucher (PRV) and preclinical portfolio. Sun Pharma Advanced Research Company Ltd submitted an investor presentation letter to the National Stock Exchange of India Ltd and BSE Limited on January 8, 2026. The communication provided details regarding a scheduled investor conference call and audio dial-in numbers for participants. It also included a web link to access the management presentation for the scheduled discussion.

guidance.claim: SPARC expects to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of this year.
guidance.quote: We expect to complete dosing to the highest dose cohort of 2.4 milligrams per kilogram by the end of the third quarter of this year.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that headcount is expected to be around 250 next year compared to over 400 people across three geographies during FY 24.
margins_costs.quote: During FY '24, we had 400 plus people across three different geographies. Next year, our headcount is expected to be around 250-ish.

margins_costs.claim: Overall operational costs are projected to go down from $31 million last year to $29 million this year.
margins_costs.quote: From 31 million last year, we are projected to go down to 29 million this year, even though we plan to scale our clinical program significantly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that two significant data readouts over the last 24 months did not go the way they hoped: the PROSEEK Phase 2 study in PD and Vibozilimod's Phase 2 trials.
risks_headwinds.quote: Over the last 24 months or so, we had two significant data readouts which did not go the way we hoped. That’s PROSEEK Phase 2 study in PD and Vibozilimod’s Phase 2 trials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies for vodobatinib has been limited largely on account of perceived market-size limitations.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the licensing interest from large pharmaceutical companies has been limited, largely on account of perceived market-size limitations, even with Asciminib’s commercial success and the rising industry interest in the next-generation TKI companies.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects to have safety and preliminary efficacy data for SCD-153 by the fourth quarter of this calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: And this is an early signal seeking study and we expect to have safety and preliminary efficacy data by the fourth quarter of this calendar year and transition the program to a, hopefully to a larger Phase 2 trial thereafter.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects top-line results for the SCD-153 Phase 1B study in Q4 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Top line results are expected in Q4, and we plan to initiate a global Phase 2 clinical study in the quarter 2 of the calendar year 2027.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects to identify the maximum tolerated dose for SBO-154 by the end of the third quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: We expect, as I mentioned, to expect to have the maximum tolerated dose, or the MTD, identified by the end of the third quarter of 2026, allowing us to proceed with cohort expansion by the end of the calendar year, and a potential early clinical proof of concept by the second half of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects the court's initial opinion on the Sezaby pediatric rare disease voucher matter in the last quarter of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: After exhausting all available reasonable options, we have approached the court for direction in February 2024 and we expect the courts initial opinion on this matter in the last quarter of this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC and Ocuvex are working closely to complete the PDP-716 CRL response by the second quarter of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We are working very closely with the current management of Ocuvex, that’s their new name, to complete the CRL response by 2nd quarter of the next financial year and ensuring a successful launch once we get the approval which we hope to get before the turn of FY26.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC expects the Atopic Dermatitis 16-week topline data for Vibozilimod in Q4 of FY25.
management_commitments.quote: Atopic dermatitis 16 week topline is expected in Q4 of FY25, while Psoriasis is expected to reach topline readout in Q1, FY26.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC anticipates an IND filing for SBO-154 by the end of Q4 FY2025.
management_commitments.quote: We anticipate an IND filing by the end of Q4 FY2025, followed by initiation of the Phase I study in the subsequent quarter.

management_commitments.claim: SPARC plans to initiate the Phase IB study of SCD-153 in Alopecia Areata patients in the first quarter of FY26.
management_commitments.quote: The Phase IB study in Alopecia Areata patients will be initiated in the Q1 of FY26.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
